entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2643842302456085888: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 33.7247 +/- 0.0169 mas (same row, RUWE 0.86): 29.65 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 375.977, 215.870 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.58 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Passegger et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of GJ 9827 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A..22P/abstract). Mass 0.62 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Passegger et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of GJ 9827 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A..22P/abstract). Temperature 4236 +/- 12 K from Passegger et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of GJ 9827 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,236 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffd8b0. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,236 K and log g 4.7 (u1 0.701, u2 0.082): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
